environment.apiCalls: none — callbacks are recorded, no network, no signed-in member session

limits: Mounted in the QA harness, not inside /app/chat after sign-in: the parent wiring (profile-view -> route) is asserted by scripts/trust/harness.ts [20], not here.

results.name: dialog mounts from the product component
title resolves through aria-labelledby
consequences are stated, not implied (3+ bullets)
focus starts on the NON-destructive choice
Tab moves into the dialog's own controls (no focus escape to the page behind)
Tab cannot walk out of the sheet — it wraps, so the page behind stays unreachable
and Shift+Tab wraps backwards instead of escaping
the wrapped focus lands on a real control, not a hidden one
the focused action shows a real ring (solid >=2px outline, or a box-shadow spread)
and so does a reason chip — the control a keyboard member rests on while choosing
Escape closes the sheet and routes to onCancel
a reason can be selected at all
the next case starts with NO stale selection — each case is a fresh mount, not a reused one
every unmatch reason is offered
a chosen reason is visibly pressed
and choosing it again clears it (reasons stay optional)
the reason reaches onConfirm — the value the route persists
the sheet stays open while the parent works (no optimistic close)
a second and third activation cannot fire a second request
a safety-shaped reason turns the sheet toward reporting
and offers the report action itself
clicking it calls onReport
ending for that reason still carries it through (report is offered, never substituted)
while the request is in flight the confirm button is aria-busy and disabled
and nothing in the sheet is clickable — no double-fire, no editing mid-request
Escape does NOT close mid-request (a closed sheet would hide a result nobody read)
backdrop click is inert while busy too
the sheet fits the 390px viewport without horizontal overflow
and reaches the bottom edge as a sheet, scrolling internally if content grows
consequence copy meets 4.5:1 on the sheet
the destructive label meets 4.5:1 on its own fill
delete-conversation is a different sheet, not the same words
and it asks for no reason (a wipe has nothing to explain to the match)
its confirm carries NO reason rather than a fabricated one
on desktop it is a centred modal, not a sheet stuck to the bottom
the read-only notice renders
it states the constraint in plain words
and never blames the connection — this is a decision, not a failure
